proposals.representative_text: what advice would you give a new streamer?
proposals.response_angle: Invite a short, actionable tip you can pin (gear, mindset, or audience habits) to help newcomers — high-value, low-effort share.
proposals.rationale: Highest-engagement cluster (46 users); a genuine community-building question that fits a stream lull.

proposals.representative_text: what goals are you working toward this month?
proposals.response_angle: State a concrete monthly target (followers, new game, community goal) so viewers can rally behind it.
proposals.rationale: Strong engagement (44 users); creator-relevant and encourages sustained viewer investment.

proposals.representative_text: how often do you take breaks while streaming?
proposals.response_angle: Share your break cadence and signal upcoming breaks so chat knows you're still present.
proposals.rationale: Relatable personal-habit question (42 users); useful during longer streams to model healthy pacing.

proposals.representative_text: what snacks do you eat during long streams?
proposals.response_angle: Light, offhand reply during a natural pause; low urgency relative to gear/planning questions.
proposals.rationale: Benign casual question (40 users); worth a brief answer but timing/context is weak.

proposals.representative_text: how do we join your discord server safely?
proposals.response_angle: Drop the official invite link and any safety/verification steps you require for new members.
proposals.rationale: Community-link question (34 users); useful but secondary to current stream content; surface during a quieter moment.
